BOL101.what: dwelling stock, 1 January, all uses and all resident types
BOL101.closed_note: DST publishes no 2021 or 2022 for BOL101 — both years are closed due to errors in the Building and Housing Register, so the net-additions window spans 6 years and is annualised over that span

BYGV33.what: dwellings by phase of construction, quarterly, all uses and all builder types — context only

meta.formula: persons_per_hh_mid = persons_per_hh + 5 × its mean yearly change over 2021–2026, total move capped at ±5% and never below 1.6; demand_5y = P_mid / persons_per_hh_mid − P_base / persons_per_hh; supply_5y = mean yearly change in the BOL101 dwelling stock 2020–2026 (6 years) × 5; gap = demand_5y − supply_5y; gap_per_1000 = gap / P_base × 1000; gap_per_1000_rel = gap_per_1000 − Denmark's own
meta.variants: demand_5y_const holds persons_per_hh at its base-year value (the first version of this indicator); supply_5y_gross is BYGV33 completions with no demolitions or mergers netted off. gap_const_gross combines the two and is kept so the effect of each fix stays visible.
meta.sign: positive gap = the projection implies more households than the recent change in the dwelling stock delivers (undersupply); negative = oversupply, including where the projection shrinks and any net additions are surplus. gap_per_1000_rel re-centres this on Denmark: positive = tighter than the country, negative = looser.
meta.pipeline_note: pipeline_permitted = permits − starts over 2025K3–2026K2, a four-quarter flow difference and not a stock; it is context only and enters no other figure. BYGV33 is not adjusted for reporting delays, so the most recent quarters are revised upward later.
meta.caveats: the household-size trend is linear and capped, not modelled; vacancy, second homes and tenure are not modelled (supply_5y_excl_cottages is carried as a check); BOL101 counts dwellings that exist, not dwellings that are available; DST's projection is not housing-driven, so it does not respond to the supply side it is compared with. See docs/FORECAST.md §7.
meta.source: Danmarks Statistik FOLK1A, FAM55N, BOL101, BYGV33 and FRKM126 (2026 municipal population projection)

backtest.truth: actual household growth (FAM55N) − actual net dwelling-stock change (BOL101), per 1 000 inhabitants at the base year
